top_stories.title: OpenAI Offering Zero Data Retention for Frontier Models
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has announced a zero data retention option for its frontier models, meaning API inputs and outputs will not be stored by default. This move is aimed at enterprise customers with stricter data privacy requirements, allowing them to use OpenAI's most capable models without their data being retained for training or other purposes.

top_stories.title: OpenAI Hit the Brakes. Now What?
top_stories.summary: The Verge examines OpenAI's decision to voluntarily slow its AI development pace, exploring what this signals for the broader AI industry and the company's internal priorities. The piece considers the implications for AI safety commitments and competitive dynamics with other frontier labs.

top_stories.title: ChatGPT Ads Expands Across Europe
top_stories.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT advertising product to European markets, broadening the commercial footprint of its flagship consumer product. This move marks a significant step in OpenAI's efforts to monetise ChatGPT beyond subscriptions.

top_stories.title: Coders Say They Already Found Workarounds to Claude's Invisible Watermarks
top_stories.summary: Wired reports that developers have identified methods to bypass the invisible watermarking system Anthropic introduced in Claude, raising questions about the effectiveness of AI-generated content detection. The findings highlight the ongoing challenge of building robust detection tools as AI output becomes more prevalent.

top_stories.title: Replit Expands Access to Software Creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
top_stories.summary: OpenAI's blog announces that Replit is integrating GPT-5.6 Luna to expand access to AI-powered software creation tools, making it easier for non-developers to build applications. The partnership reflects OpenAI's push to embed its latest models into developer-facing platforms.

further_links.title: I Saw the Future of AI in a Robot That Can Learn on the Spot
further_links.summary: Wired reports on a new generation of generalist AI robots capable of learning new tasks on the fly, drawing comparisons to how toddlers acquire skills through observation and interaction. [Metered]

further_links.title: Google Gemini is Getting a Dedicated Student Hub
further_links.summary: Google is adding a dedicated student hub to Gemini, positioning the AI assistant as a tool for education and academic use.

further_links.title: The Download: AI's Self-Improvement Problem, and What's Driving the Heat
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review covers the emerging challenge of AI recursive self-improvement and the technical and safety risks it presents as models become more capable. [Metered]

further_links.title: AI for Society Opens as Interdisciplinary Journal Covering Education, Governance and AI
further_links.summary: A new academic journal, AI for Society, has launched to publish interdisciplinary research spanning AI's impact on education, governance, and broader societal issues.

further_links.title: Meta AI is Getting a Mac App
further_links.summary: Meta is launching a dedicated Mac application for its Meta AI assistant, expanding its presence on desktop platforms.

further_links.title: AI Usage Patterns in Software Teams
further_links.summary: Linear has published data on how software development teams are actually using AI tools, offering insight into real-world adoption patterns and productivity effects.

further_links.title: Goldman Studied Where AI is Squeezing Labor Markets. Here's What It Found
further_links.summary: Goldman Sachs research finds AI is beginning to have a measurable impact on employment across developed economies, with certain knowledge-work roles showing signs of displacement.

further_links.title: The Download: How People Really Use AI, and Flock's Design Choices
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines new research into real-world AI usage behaviours alongside a look at how surveillance tech company Flock Safety designs its AI tools. [Metered]

further_links.title: Nvidia's New Financial Strategy Does Not Compute
further_links.summary: The Verge analyses Nvidia's emerging financial strategy involving Goldman Sachs and BlackRock around GPU compute assets, raising questions about the underlying economics.

further_links.title: AI Market Correction is Coming, ECB Blog Predicts
further_links.summary: An ECB blog post warns that AI valuations may be unsustainable and predicts a market correction is likely as the gap between AI investment and measurable economic returns widens.
